decision.reason: Example only: placeholder release identity and production evidence must never approve traffic.

controls.notes: Select and review the runtime and managed PostgreSQL provider.
Prove DNS, TLS renewal, same-site origins, proxy hops, and private API reachability.
Select the runtime secret manager and complete a rotation and revocation drill.
Select collection and retention, derive actionable thresholds, and test delivery.
Validate aggregate connections and representative staging workload.
Complete a timed isolated provider PITR drill against the selected database.
Restore a portable archive and pass Atlas recovery validation.
Scan dependencies and every published platform digest for the release candidate.
Verify candidate source, migrations, SBOM, provenance, signatures, and digests.
Record previous digests, schema compatibility, operator, and traffic rollback.
Run the exact candidate through bounded staging smoke tests.
Complete a timed exercise using the current runbook and contact path.
Approve simulated-only scope, privacy and support ownership, and disabled real custody.
